name: immortal-blossoms
description: Immortal Blossoms: a premium, fully offline xianxia card-battle RPG. The web game builds into dist/; Capacitor wraps it as an Android app (see .github/workflows/android.yml).

scripts.android: python3 tools/build_game.py && python3 tools/offline_fonts.py && npx cap add android && python3 tools/android_setup.py && npx cap sync android
